page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.16xlarge is a dedicated instance from the Enhanced family, built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz, supplying 64 dedicated vCPUs. The platform integrates 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 processor-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server includes no hardware GPU accelerators.

Local storage is not present on this instance type, requiring workloads to rely on remote cloud storage solutions for persistent and temporary data storage. In terms of network connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 36 Gbps. It includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its balanced compute and memory distribution, dedicated virtual CPU cores, and high baseline networking throughput, ecs.g9it.16xlarge fits multi-threaded enterprise application tiers, large-scale container platforms, database servers utilizing networked storage, and distributed processing environments.
